nodes.name: Editor Page (Redesigned)
nodes.responsibility: Unified post editor supporting three modes: create new, edit existing, continue draft. Auto-saves drafts with debounce. Character count, title validation, content preview toggle.

nodes.name: Drafts List Page
nodes.responsibility: Lists all saved drafts for the current user. Tap to continue editing, swipe/button to delete. Shows title preview, content preview, last-saved timestamp, category label.

nodes.name: Drafts Service
nodes.responsibility: Data access layer for drafts: save, list, get, delete. Wraps cloud function calls. Handles local-storage fallback for offline drafts.

nodes.name: Drafts DB Collection
nodes.responsibility: Persistent cloud storage for user drafts: _openid, title, content, category_id, anonymous flag, updated_at. One user can have multiple drafts.

nodes.name: Posts Cloud Function (Extended)
nodes.responsibility: Existing create/search/delete + new update action for editing published posts. Validates author ownership. Updates updated_at timestamp.

nodes.name: Drafts Cloud Function
nodes.responsibility: CRUD for drafts: save (upsert by draft_id), list by user, get by id, delete by id. Authentication required for all actions.

nodes.name: My Posts Page (Modified)
nodes.responsibility: Existing post list + new edit button per post. Edit button navigates to editor in edit mode. Delete button unchanged.

nodes.name: Editor Type Definitions
nodes.responsibility: New types: IDraft interface, IUpdatePostData interface, EditorMode enum, draft-related API result types

edges.description: Auto-save draft via service; load draft on enter
Tap draft navigates to editor with draft_id in query params
All draft operations go through cloud function for auth
Edit button navigates to editor with post_id in query params (edit mode)

boundary_conditions.description: Concurrent edit conflict: user edits a post on two devices simultaneously
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Last-write-wins; updated_at timestamp reflects the most recent save. No merge logic in v1.

boundary_conditions.description: Draft data loss: user closes editor without saving, or app crashes mid-edit
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Auto-save fires on every input (debounced 2s). On editor open, checks for unsaved draft and offers to restore.

boundary_conditions.description: Edit permission bypass: user attempts to edit another user's post via deep link
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: update action verifies post._openid === authenticated openid; returns FORBIDDEN on mismatch

boundary_conditions.description: Draft count unbounded growth: user accumulates hundreds of drafts
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Hard cap of 50 drafts per user. Save refuses when at limit. UI warns on save attempt.

boundary_conditions.description: Publish from draft clears draft: draft must be deleted when post is successfully published
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: On successful createPost/updatePost, editor calls deleteDraft for the source draft_id

boundary_conditions.description: Content length limits differ between title (200) and content (10000)
boundary_conditions.failure_mode: Client-side character counter displays remaining characters. Cloud function re-validates on submit.

notes: Editor uses a unified page with mode parameter (create | edit | draft) rather than three separate pages.
Drafts are stored in CloudBase (not local storage) for cross-device access. Local storage is a fallback for offline saves.
The posts cloud function's new 'update' action reuses the existing validateInput and filterSensitiveWords utilities.
Image upload is explicitly out of scope for v1. Content remains plain text only.
Rich text (bold, italic, links) is out of scope for v1. Content is plain text with optional line breaks.
